description: The report-group PRESENT WHEN clause (§2023:13.18.41 Format 1) — the entry (and its subordinates) is processed only when condition-1 is true, evaluated once per group presentation before any LINE clause processing (GR2); an absent entry is processed as though omitted (GR2b — relative lines re-anchor, absent items leave spaces, an absent SUM entry neither prints nor resets, GR3g). LIVE (P10 Step 13): conditions bind through the ONE ConditionBinder onto the report model; the RWCS engine evaluates per presentation. 2002 introduction — the 2023 Annex E covers 2014→2023 only; derived from the §2023:8.9 reservation of PRESENT 'added 2002' (ReservedWords.Table — the word was reserved FOR this clause) + the 2002 RW modernization family.
vcr: 2002 RW addition (PRESENT reserved 'added 2002'; Annex E 2014→2023 has no introduction hit ⇒ predates 2014)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRPW1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrpw1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-F PIC 9 VALUE 1.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE PLUS 1.
      05 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "OK" PRESENT WHEN W-F = 1.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
